summary: Iteration 5 (5 new features) verified end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass in test_new_features_v5.py covering (a) WebP assets served (/exercises/bench-press.webp 200, no PNG fallback), (b) FormCheck premium gating (free user gets 402/403 on /api/formcheck/analyze AND /api/formcheck/history; admin gets 200 history + structured analyze response or 400 'no_pose_detected' for solid-color image), (c) BodyScan plan-adjust premium gate + 404 on missing scan, (d) Push notifications full lifecycle: GET /api/notifications/vapid-public-key returns 88-char key without auth, POST /api/notifications/subscribe persists, GET /api/notifications/settings returns it with correct reminder_time + triggers, PUT /api/notifications/settings updates reminder_time (07:30→08:45) and triggers correctly, DELETE /api/notifications/unsubscribe?endpoint=... removes (deleted=1), POST /api/notifications/test returns {subscriptions, sent}, /api/notifications/subscribe requires auth (401/403), (e) /sw.js served 200 with push + notificationclick handlers (1544 bytes). Frontend (Playwright): /library is PUBLIC and renders 45 exercise cards grouped by muscle (BRUST first), 9 filter chips filter-all/chest/back/shoulders/biceps/triceps/legs/core/cardio all present; search 'bank' filters to 4 cards (Bankdrücken/Schrägbankdrücken/Kurzhantel-Bankdrücken etc), filter-legs shows 9 cards. /library/bench-press shows library-detail with 4 numbered cyan tips (library-tip-0..3), SICHERHEITS-HINWEIS disclaimer, library-back ZURÜCK button, large WebP image (/exercises/bench-press.webp). Dashboard renders both dashboard-bodyscan-cta + dashboard-library-cta side-by-side. Layout header gear settings-btn navigates to /settings. /settings shows PUSH-BENACHRICHTIGUNGEN section with push-enable-btn (headless browser shows 'Browser-Berechtigung verweigert' which is expected — actual push permission cannot be granted in CI). Admin /formcheck (premium) hides gate and shows formcheck-upload UI with exercise-input + upload-btn correctly disabled until exercise filled, and ?exercise=Squat deep-link pre-fills the input. Service Worker registered with /sw.js scriptURL on /dashboard load. ActiveWorkout has active-formcheck-btn that navigates to /formcheck?exercise=...&muscle=... (verified via deep-link pre-fill).

minor.issue: Model is hardcoded as with_model('openai', 'gpt-5.5'). All other vision endpoints (bodyscan/nutrition) use gpt-5.2 or gpt-5.5. Worth confirming this is intentional vs typo; not a bug since the LLM proxy may accept it.

The gate component IS in /app/frontend/src/pages/FormCheck.jsx and the API gate is verified (402/403) for non-premium. Once onboarding is completed, the gate should render — main agent should self-verify with an onboarded-but-not-premium account.

action_items: (Optional) Confirm /api/formcheck/analyze model 'gpt-5.5' is intentional — other endpoints in server.py use 'gpt-5.2' (e.g. body scan). If a typo, change to 'gpt-5.2'.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2415 lines (was 1974 in iter 4, 1849 in iter 3). The 700-line guideline keeps being exceeded — formcheck, push notifications, bodyscan adjust, coach, profile, nutrition, sessions etc should be split into APIRouter modules under /app/backend/routers/.
push_dispatcher_loop runs every minute scanning ALL subscriptions in DB - no index on (user_id, endpoint). For scale add unique compound index on push_subscriptions.
FormCheckRequest.image_base64 has no size cap — clients could POST very large data URLs. Consider explicit max_length validator or pre-check.
Form Check endpoint uses 'openai', 'gpt-5.5' — inconsistent with body_scan ('gpt-5.2'). Likely either typo or intentional newer model. Either way, document.
_send_web_push fires asyncio.create_task inside a synchronous function for cleanup of 404/410 subscriptions — works but mixing sync/async is brittle. Consider making it fully async.

/library route appears publicly accessible (no auth required) — confirmed working as designed per request, but Layout still renders header gear+logout buttons for anonymous users (cosmetic only, those buttons should arguably hide when not authenticated). Cosmetic; not a regression.
